title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
statement:
Given an integer array nums, find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

A subsequence is a sequence that can be derived from an array by deleting some or no elements without changing the order of the remaining elements.

visibleExamples.explanation: The longest increasing subsequence is [2,3,7,101], therefore the length is 4.
The longest increasing subsequence is [0,1,4] which has length 4. Other valid sequences include [0,1,2,3] with length 4.
The longest increasing subsequence is [3,10,20] with length 3.
